title: Diffusion and reaction in the quasi-spherical equation: mean curvature deformations for fill-Ins
summary: We study the diffusion and reaction effects of Bartnik's quasi-spherical equation to deform boundary mean curvature in fill-in problems with scalar curvature bounded below. The diffusion effect yields an explicit $L^p$-to-$L^\infty$ estimate for $\partial_tu=u^2Δu$, thereby extending the known upper bound for the minimum boundary mean curvature of fill-ins to a quantitative upper bound for its harmonic mean.
